name: voice-mode
title: Voice Mode
description: A spoken conversation with the agent, the audio the app's: an orb (VoiceModeOrb) whose rings swell with the level of whoever is heard (the reader listening, the agent speaking; a CSS variable, set as often as the app likes), its disc breathing while it thinks, faint while it connects, grey with the mic struck out while muted, still where less motion is asked for, a button that interrupts the agent while it speaks (onInterrupt); a word of where it is, announced (VoiceModeStatus); the last lines said (VoiceModeCaptions of VoiceModeCaption, the agent's in the text's colour, the reader's grey, interim greyer), not announced; round buttons (VoiceModeControls: VoiceModeMute, pressed while muted, VoiceModeEnd, and the app's VoiceModeButton). variant full fills its place (a panel, a sheet, a phone's page): the orb 192px (160 on a phone) and its status in the middle, three lines of captions fading upward, the buttons at the foot over the home indicator. variant bar is a 56px row in the composer's place, as its box: a small orb, the status (read out only on a phone), the latest line kept to its end as it grows, the buttons.
